title: Senior Commercial Counsel
description:
At Signifyd , we help merchants confidently grow their businesses by building trusted relationships with their customers. Our advanced technology, combined with a team genuinely invested in our clients’ success, creates frictionless shopping experiences, approving more good orders, protecting revenue, and keeping customers happy.

Trusted by thousands of leading merchants across more than 100 countries, we securely process billions of transactions each year. Our people are the heart of everything we do, driving our mission forward with commitment, empathy, and creativity. Join us on our mission to empower confident, fraud-free commerce by helping online retailers provide superior customer experiences and eliminate fraud. Learn about our company values here!

Job Title: Senior Commercial Counsel
Department: Legal
The Legal team at Signifyd plays a critical role in enabling and protecting the business as it scales. Our team is responsible for drafting and negotiating sales and vendor contracts, reviewing privacy and data protection matters, and supporting product development. We work closely with the Sales, Partnerships, Product, Revenue Operations (RevOps), and Finance teams to help drive business objectives forward. By shaping processes that accelerate deal cycles, we help keep the commercial flywheel turning. At the same time, we ensure Signifyd 's risk exposure is carefully managed and our sensitive data is safeguarded through robust contractual protections.
The Role:
This is a unique opportunity to join a dedicated legal team and work at the forefront of helping deliver fraud detection and prevention solutions to merchants around the world. Signifyd is seeking a Senior Commercial Counsel to join our Legal team and report to our Head of Commercial Legal. You will be responsible for reviewing, drafting, revising, negotiating, and advising on a broad range of complex commercial transactions - someone who gets deals done. You'll primarily support our global sales team to structure, draft, and negotiate a variety of go-to-market agreements, while also leading a team of contracts managers who support the Sales organization across the U.S., EMEA, Mexico, and Central and South America.
In addition to go-to-market work, you'll partner closely with other key stakeholders to structure and negotiate complex, often bespoke agreements for enterprise and strategic partnership engagements. The ideal candidate is a mid-level to senior attorney who enjoys close collaboration with legal and sales colleagues and approaches legal issues practically, with a problem-solving mindset. Experience with payments, fintech, or machine learning is a plus.
Responsibilities:

• Independently draft and negotiate complex subscription agreements and partnership deals, working closely with our Sales organization to close revenue deals

• Supporting a go-to-market portfolio of ecommerce merchants across the U.S., EMEA, Mexico, and South America

• Support cross-functional teams - including Marketing, Partnerships, and Product - on commercial and vendor transactions

• Assist with additional legal projects as needed to support Signifyd 's rapid growth and expansion

• Manage numerous projects simultaneously against competing deadlines and pressures

• Exercise sound legal judgment and solve problems in a practical, business-minded way

Requirements:

• Juris Doctor (JD) degree and active admission to at least one U.S. state bar.

• 5-10+ yearsof experience, with a strong preference supporting a SalesOrganization and background in commercial and tech transactions and revenue-generating deals

• A clear, concise communicator who can explain complex and nuanced issues in plain, simple terms

• Experience supporting a global sales organization and keeping pace with a steady volume of commercial transactions in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

• Strong organizational and project management skills

• Comfortable working in lean teams and wearing multiple hats

title: GERENTE DE PROJETOS
description:
SOBRE A CERTSYS
A Certsys é uma empresa especializada em Transformação Digital que, desde 2007, apoia organizações por meio de soluções tecnológicas inovadoras e escaláveis. Com uma cultura colaborativa, ágil e transparente, tem como propósito revolucionar negócios e impactar pessoas por meio da tecnologia. Além disso, é reconhecida como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil, sendo certificada pelo GPTW por dois anos consecutivos.
MISSÃO DO CARGO
Gestão do Projeto
Acompanhar o cronograma oficial do projeto, comparando realizado x planejado por pacote e por fase;
Gerenciar riscos, escopo e os planos de contingência de prazo, equipe e escopo;
Conduzir reuniões de status semanais com GTI, NTD e os desenvolvedores dos pacotes;
Elaborar relatórios executivos mensais de status para a alta administração;
Escalonar imediatamente para NTD/GTI desvios superiores a 15% no prazo de qualquer pacote;
Coordenar os checkpoints de homologação e a aprovação de go-live de cada pacote.
Análise de Negócio / Sistemas
Levantar e documentar, junto às áreas usuárias, os requisitos funcionais e as regras de negócio dos sistemas a serem migrados;
Validar e manter atualizado o inventário de sistemas (telas, relatórios, complexidade), identificando divergências entre o escopo mapeado e a realidade de cada sistema;
Mapear os processos de negócio impactados pela migração e definir, junto às áreas, os critérios de aceite e homologação por sistema;
Conduzir o piloto de calibração de esforço (migração de amostra de telas e relatórios) para validar as estimativas de esforço por pacote;
Elaborar e manter a documentação técnico-funcional dos sistemas migrados;
Organizar e planejar os testes de homologação, validando a aderência funcional entre o sistema legado e a versão migrada em Forms 12c.
VOCÊ PRECISA TER:

• Experiência comprovada em gestão de projetos de TI, preferencialmente de migração ou modernização de sistemas legados.

• Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de cronograma (MS Project ou equivalente).

• Conhecimento de gestão de riscos, análise de viabilidade (esforço x capacidade) e planos de contingência.

• Experiência em governança de projetos: reuniões de status, relatórios executivos e escalonamento de desvios.

• Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia ou áreas afins.

• Experiência mínima de 3 a 5 anos em gestão de projetos de TI de porte comparável.

VOCÊ SE DESTACA SE TIVER:

• Conhecimento técnico sobre Oracle Forms e processos de migração entre versões.

• Certificação em gestão de projetos (PMP, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2 ou similar).

• Experiência com equipes mistas (recursos internos + temporários contratados).

• Vivência em órgãos públicos ou entidades do sistema S.

FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA:

• Graduação na área de TI ou graduação em qualquer área acompanhada de pós-graduação em TI.

Informações adicionais
Modelo de Trabalho: PJ (TEMPORÁRIO)
Horário de trabalho: Das 10:00 as 19:00hrs.
Local de trabalho: Remoto

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer - Data-Centric Engineering
description:
Do you like collaborating across teams to solve complex problems?
Do you enjoy solving large scale distributed systems problems?
Join the Mapping SRE team
As Akamai Mapping Data-Driven SREs, we leverage advanced data science, statistical modeling, and machine learning to optimize the reliability, performance, and scalability of a global system routing trillions of daily client requests and tens of terabits of traffic per second. We analyze massive, high-dimensional datasets to discover predictive insights, design critical KPIs, and build advanced algorithmic monitoring infrastructure. Our unique data-first methodology allows us to precisely measure, model, and continuously optimize how our mapping architecture impacts customer performance.
Partner with the best
As a Data-Centric Site Reliability Engineer, you will apply rigorous quantitative analysis, statistical modeling, and machine learning to optimize the performance, availability, and routing algorithms of Akamai’s core Mapping Service. In this high-impact role, you will analyze massive telemetry streams, engineer predictive observability tools, and design data-driven architecture strategies. Operating at the forefront of data science and large-scale systems engineering, you will unlock deep analytical insights to diagnose and solve the internet’s most complex content delivery challenges.
Note: This is a specialized data science and analytical engineering role requiring advanced quantitative and modeling expertise-not a standard DevOps, sysadmin, or routine operational position.
As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you will be responsible for:

•
Advanced Statistical Modeling: Develop mathematical, statistical, and machine learning models to analyze global traffic flows, predict latency anomalies, and optimize routing efficiency.

•
Drive Observability & Analytics: Design, track, and refine data-driven SLIs/SLOs, utilizing exploratory data analysis to proactively identify hidden bottlenecks and systemic performance trends.

•
Engineer Predictive Tooling: Build and deploy automated data pipelines, predictive models, and custom diagnostic algorithms to detect, prevent, and analyze complex platform anomalies.

•
Advocate for Reliability: Partner with product engineers to champion scalable, resilient, and highly supportable system architectures.

•
Influence Strategy: Provide data-driven insights to guide executive-level decision-making and identify high-impact technology investments.

•
Deep Root-Cause Analytics: Conduct advanced quantitative investigations and forensic telemetry analyses on complex system outages and high-priority performance escalations.

Do what you love
To be successful in this role you will:

• Master’s or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a highly quantitative analytical field.

• 5+ years of experience applying data science, predictive modeling, or quantitative research to large-scale distributed systems or tech environments.

• Deep mastery of Unix/Linux internals, computer networking protocols, and distributed system design.

• Professional fluency operating within a command-line UNIX/Linux computing environment.

• Data & Observability

• Expertise in statistical analysis, machine learning algorithms, time-series forecasting, and advanced SQL/NoSQL big data querying.

• Proven ability to transform complex datasets into actionable strategic roadmaps.

• Practical knowledge of enterprise observability, logging, and alerting systems like Grafana.

• Data Science & Communication Skills

• High proficiency in data science languages and frameworks (e.g., Python, R, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch).

• Self-motivated communicator capable of articulating complex systems to non-technical stakeholders while managing multiple timelines.

About us

Venn is the leader in workspace security for remote and contractor workforces. Built on Venn 's patented technology, Blue Border™ protects company data, applications, and AI workflows on any computer, without VDI and without fully managing the endpoint. Installing Blue Border creates a company-controlled secure enclave directly on the user's Mac or PC. All business activity, including data, applications, networking, and AI workflows, runs locally and stays isolated from personal use, while everything outside the enclave remains private.

More than 700 security and compliance-driven organizations, including Fidelity, Guardian, Whatnot, and the IMF, trust Venn to meet HIPAA, FINRA, SEC, NAIC, SOC 2, PCI, and GDPR standards.

title: Stage Mechatronica: EPLAN Fluid
description: Wat ga je doen? Tijdens deze stageopdracht duik je in de huidige manier van werken rondom hydrauliek- en pneumatiekschema’s binnen NPD Mechanical Engineering. Op dit moment worden de schema’s opgesteld op een manier die niet-configureerbaar is en beperkte mogelijkheden biedt, bijvoorbeeld als het gaat om het printen en hergebruiken van coderingen. Je onderzoekt hoe EPLAN Fluid het beste ingezet kan worden om de huidige aanpak eventueel te vervangen. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar “hoe het kan”, maar vooral naar “hoe het moet”. Je werkt hierbij samen met engineers en krijgt de ruimte om zelf initiatief te nemen. Je sluit af met een proof of concept: een volledig hydraulisch en pneumatisch machineschema dat als referentie kan dienen voor nieuwe machineontwikkeling. Mogelijke onderdelen van je opdracht: In kaart brengen van de huidige werkwijze en knelpunten rond hydrauliek- en pneumatiekschema’s; Opstellen van een gestandaardiseerde werkwijze; Verkennen van configuratie- en documentatiemogelijkheden binnen EPLAN Fluid; Bouwen van een proof of concept als referentie; Opleveren van een korte handleiding en overdracht naar de engineers. Wij vragen Een HBO-opleiding in de richting van Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar. Wij bieden Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand; Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt; Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software; Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen; Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

title: Senior Partner Engagement Manager

description:
Knowt is the study app about 8 million high schoolers use to get through AP classes, the SAT and ACT, finals, and college apps. We’re looking for someone to be the face and voice of Knowt’s high school social presence. You’ll own our TikTok and Instagram (@getknowt) end to end and make them the account students actually want to follow: funny, relatable, and useful.
This isn’t a brand marketing job. You’re not talking at high schoolers. You’re one of them, or close enough that you still speak the language. You know the 2am cram sessions, the group chat panic before an AP exam, the SAT score reveal, and the Common App essay spiral, and you know how to turn all of it into content that hits.
The basics

• Part-time, 15-20 hrs/week

• Fully remote

• Base pay plus performance bonuses tied to account growth

• You’ll report to our Student Marketing Manager and work with her every day

• You’ll start with an established account: 476K followers, backed by a platform 8 million students use. You’re not building from zero.

What you’ll do
Create

• Post one talk-to-camera video every day to TikTok and Instagram. You’re on screen.

• Take each video from idea to posted: hook, script, filming, editing, caption.

• Make content about what high schoolers are actually dealing with (AP exams, the SAT and ACT, finals, college apps, test stress) and make it feel like it came from a friend, not a company.

• Work Knowt into content naturally, so students want to watch it and then use the app.

• Keep every post native to the platform and to high school culture: current sounds, formats, humor, and slang that’s actually in use, not cringe.

Grow

• Keep testing hooks, formats, storytelling angles, and CTAs to find winning formulas you can repeat.

• Plan content around the school calendar so you reach students exactly when they need Knowt: AP season, SAT and ACT test dates, finals, application deadlines.

• Turn trends, comment sections, and performance data into new content ideas.

Own the results

• Send a weekly recap: what performed, what didn’t, and what you’re changing next.

• Track views, watch time, saves, shares, comments, and signups, and make the call on what to scale, fix, or drop.

• Stay ahead of the schedule. Film in batches so the account never misses a day.

How we work together
Every post is reviewed by our Student Marketing Manager before it goes live. That’s not a committee rewriting your hooks. It’s a fast feedback loop with someone who knows this audience and this account inside out. Expect notes on most videos early on, fewer as you find your rhythm. You’ll need to build time into your week for revisions and turn feedback around within 24 hours.
What we’re looking for
You need:

• Experience running and growing an account, your own or a brand’s. Show us the numbers.

• Real comfort on camera. You’ll be on screen every day, so this is non-negotiable.

• Fluency in high school culture. You’ve lived AP classes, standardized tests, and application season recently enough that it still feels like your world.

• An instinct for what goes viral on TikTok and Instagram, and the ability to explain why.

• Reliability. You hit deadlines, respond to feedback quickly, and treat the account like it’s yours.

• A data-driven approach. Your creative calls are backed by views and conversion data.

Nice to have:

• Experience scripting for other creators

• Strong AP, SAT, or ACT results of your own (credibility goes a long way with this audience)

Why this one’s worth it

• A real audience from day one. Growing an account this size is something you can point to for years.

• Real ownership. You set the creative direction, and your ideas don’t get lost in layers of approval. You get direct feedback from one person who wants you to win.

• A small team that moves fast. You’ll work directly with our Student Marketing Manager, with access to our CMO.

• Flexible hours, plus

Graphcore is a globally recognised leader in Artificial Intelligence computing systems. The company designs advanced semiconductors and data centre hardware that provide the specialised processing power needed to drive AI innovation, while delivering the efficiency required to support its broader adoption.   

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. We are opening a new AI Engineering Campus in Austin, which will play a central role in Graphcore's work building the future of AI computing. 

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced  Manufacturing Test Engineer  to support high-volume server manufacturing from board-level test through system-level production test. This role will work closely with an ODM manufacturing partner to define, implement, validate, and optimize the manufacturing test strategy for  L6 board-level products , including  ICT, MDA, and Board Functional Test , as well as support  L10 system-level manufacturing test .

The ideal candidate has strong experience in server hardware manufacturing, Linux-based test environments, diagnostic test coverage, fixture requirements, yield improvement, and root cause corrective action processes. This role requires both technical depth and hands-on manufacturing execution experience, with the ability to drive best practices across test development, factory readiness, quality planning, and ongoing production support.

 

Key Responsibilities

Manufacturing Test Strategy and Planning

• Work with ODM partners to define and execute the manufacturing test strategy for  L6 board-level production .

• In-Circuit Test, or ICT

• Manufacturing Defect Analyzer, or MDA

• Board Functional Test

• Diagnostic coverage requirements

• Manufacturing line test flow

• Failure detection and containment strategy

• Ensure test plans provide appropriate coverage for board-level defects, assembly issues, component-level failures, and functional performance requirements.

• Partner with hardware engineering, design validation, diagnostics, operations, quality, and ODM teams to align manufacturing test coverage with product risk areas.

L6 Board-Level Test Development and Deployment

• Define requirements for board-level test stations, fixtures, test software, diagnostic content, and production test infrastructure.

• Support the development, validation, and release of board functional tests into the ODM manufacturing environment.

• Review ICT and MDA coverage reports and drive improvements to ensure adequate manufacturing defect detection.

• Define pass/fail criteria, test limits, data collection requirements, retest rules, and failure handling processes.

• Support bring-up, debug, and qualification of manufacturing test processes during NPI and production ramp.

L10 System-Level Manufacturing Test

• Support development and deployment of  L10 system-level manufacturing test  processes.

• Port board functional tests into the L10 manufacturing environment where appropriate.

• Ensure L10 test coverage validates system-level integration, board functionality, firmware readiness, thermal behavior, power behavior, I/O functionality, and platform health.

• Work with ODM and internal engineering teams to ensure test execution is scalable, repeatable, and suitable for high-volume server production.

Manufacturing Line and Fixture Requirements

• Specify manufacturing line requirements for test station configuration, test sequencing, data capture, networking, tooling, and operator workflow.

• Define requirements for test fixtures, cabling, adapters, load boards, debug interfaces, power delivery, signal access, and fixture maintenance.

• Ensure fixtures and test stations meet manufacturing requireme

title: Scientific Software Engineer (Lab Integration)
description:
ABOUT CUSPAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a Scientific Software Engineer to build and run the systems that connect our AI platform to physical laboratories around the world. Together with the team, you will shape the software layer of our closed-loop discovery workflow: our agents propose experiments, partner labs execute them, and the results feed back into our models to guide the next set of experiments.

This role sits between lab automation and production engineering. You will bring hands-on experience with scientific or lab automation, and the engineering discipline to make those integrations secure, reliable and scalable across many partners.

You will be part of a small team of materials scientists, ML engineers and software engineers, working closely with each other and with our partner labs. You will help define how our AI platform connects to the physical world and shape the tools and practices that link external partner labs to our platform. You will thrive here if you enjoy collaborating across disciplines and learning from people whose expertise differs from your own.

YOUR IMPACT

You will turn experimental labs into first-class, programmable parts of the CuspAI platform. Every partner you onboard, and every integration you harden, shortens the loop between an AI-generated hypothesis and a validated material.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Help shape how we connect to partner labs around the world, accounting for different levels of automation and AI-readiness, then design, build and operate the services that send experiment requests from our AI agents and reliably bring results back.

- Build APIs and data models (e.g. FastAPI, Pydantic) for bidirectional lab-to-cloud data exchange.

- Integrate with lab instruments, robotic platforms, LIMS/ELN systems and scheduling software, translating between disparate formats and CuspAI's data platform.

- Make integrations reliable at scale: idempotency, retries, queueing, monitoring and alerting across many partners and time zones.

- Assist with the technical onboarding of new lab partners, assessing their systems and setting up integrations quickly and repeatedly.

- Collaborate day to day with experimental materials scientists, optimisation experts and engineers on the team, co-designing workflows and feeding lab realities back into platform design.

- Deploy and run containerised services on cloud infrastructure, with testing and CI/CD as standard.

MUST HAVE SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

- Hands-on experience with lab automation, self-driving labs or other scientific discovery workflows, e.g. instrument control, robotic platforms, or high-throughput experimentation data pipelines.

- Strong software engineering background, with production experience building and operating backend services.

- Deep fluency in Python, including typed, well-tested code and API design.

- Experience designing distributed systems that integrate with external parties: APIs, message queues or event-driven architectures, and data contracts.

- Solid understanding of security practices

title: Senior Influencer Marketing Project Manager
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships - all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open - we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

Ben jij de influencer-goeroe die wij zoeken?

Volg jij de nieuwste features op Instagram, TikTok, YouTube en Snapchat op de voet? Weet jij precies welke influencers op dit moment hot zijn? Beheers je zowel het Nederlands als het Engels vloeiend? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Over WPP Media

WPP Media is een dochteronderneming van WPP, het wereldwijde advertisingconglomeraat. We ondersteunen toonaangevende mediabureaus zoals Wavemaker, Mindshare en EssenceMediacom. Binnen WPP Media zijn verschillende centrale activiteiten ondergebracht, waaronder StudioM, Digital Data Hub, Business Intelligence, Proces Management, Marketing Services & Insights, Trading en Quality Management.

WPP Media is een dynamische, jonge en ambitieuze organisatie met duizenden (young) professionals wereldwijd. In Nederland hebben we kantoren in Amsterdam, Eindhoven en Sittard. Daar werken honderden collega’s voor toonaangevende klanten zoals Action, Lamb Weston, NS, Subway, M&M’s, Brabantia, IKEA en Dr. Oetker.

Ons kantoor in Amsterdam biedt een adembenemend uitzicht van 180 graden over de stad en de Amstel. De sfeer is informeel en gezellig, met regelmatig vrijdagmiddagborrels in onze skybar op de negende verdieping.

Over StudioM en de functie

Je gaat aan de slag bij StudioM, ons interne bureau voor influencer marketing. We voeren campagnes uit op grote, vaak internationale schaal. Je werkt met een breed scala aan klanten, influencers en campagnes, waardoor geen dag hetzelfde is.

In deze rol draag je zelfstandig de operationele verantwoordelijkheid voor complexe en omvangrijke projecten. Denk aan multi-marketprojecten, strategische accounts, campagnes voor meerdere merken en innovatieve trajecten.

Wat ga je doen?

• Projectmanagement: Je bent zelfstandig verantwoordelijk voor het opzetten, uitvoeren en coördineren van influencer marketingcampagnes.

• Planning en voortgang: Je stuurt de dagelijkse uitvoering aan, maakt duidelijke projectplanningen en bewaakt deadlines, afhankelijkheden, prioriteiten en de voortgang van projecten.

• Influencerselectie en briefings: Je vertaalt de kaders en briefings van de accountmanager naar concrete selectielijsten, taken en creatieve briefings, waaronder influencerbriefings. Waar nodig verdeel je taken onder junior collega’s of stagiairs.

• Relatiebeheer en onderhandelingen: Je onderhoudt relaties met influencers en talentbureaus en onderhandelt zelfstandig over marktconforme vergoedingen binnen het vastgestelde budget.

• Budgetbeheer en administratie: Je beheert projectbudgetten en houdt kosten bij, zoals influencer fees, buy-outs en event- en productiekosten. Ook verzorg je contracten en regel je boekingen met bureaus.

• Content en kwaliteit: Je bewaakt de voortgang en kwaliteit van alle content en deliverables, voert eerste contentchecks uit en werkt nauw samen met accountmanagers richting definitieve goedkeuring.

• Afstemming en rapportage: Je werkt samen met interne teams om effectieve campagnes te realiseren. Je houdt klanten, stakeholders en de accountmanager proactief op de hoogte van de dagelijkse voortgang, sluit waar nodig aan bij klantupdates en rapporteert over resultaten en aandachtspunten.

• Risicobeheersing en optimalisatie: Je signaleert risico’s, knelpunten en optimalisatiemogelijkheden, bespreekt deze met de (senior) accountmanager

title: Staff Robotics Software Engineer, CUAS, Omen
tags: Tech Maneuver Dominance Div Engineering : Air Maneuver Engineering : Robotics Software
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Maneuver Dominance team at Anduril develops operationally relevant, multi-asset autonomy. Omen is Anduril’s hover-to-cruise autonomous air vehicle (AAV) that packs the endurance, payload, and mission flexibility of much larger airplanes into a novel runway-independent Group 3 platform. Omen can operate from ship decks, beaches, or remote island clearings, providing true runway independence and freedom of maneuver across defense and civilian domains. Omen is the first tail-sitter aircraft with a mass-production contract, with an order of 50 systems representing a decisive investment that anchors production and accelerates the development of future systems.

ABOUT THE JOB

Small drones are hard to hit. Hitting them from a moving aircraft is harder. We need a Staff Software Engineer to own software integration of Omen’s airborne counter-UAS effector payload end to end, and to build the team around it.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Own and lead the autonomy architecture for Omen’s cUAS dogfighting mission end to end, from first prototype to fielded software. Find the target, fly the fight, take the shot.

• Collaborate with the Omen Perception team to develop target tracking and perception. Architect the optimal approach to combine data from multiple sensor sources to meet demanding mission objectives.

• Design the intercept guidance and pursuit planning that puts the aircraft in a firing position against a maneuvering target, within the vehicle’s operational limits.

• Work alongside the Omen Autonomy team which owns core autonomy systems and will embed autonomy engineers on your team for specific tactics development.

• Own fire control software. Lead and ballistic solutions, targeting commands, and the logic that decides when to shoot.

• Hold the sensor-to-shot latency budget and know where every millisecond goes.

• Own software interfaces with the payload, vehicle, and mission compute. Message definitions, timing, time sync, and command authority.

• Build the simulation that proves the engagement works before flight. Then plan and run flight test campaigns, including live range events, and lead the root-cause work when results don’t match prediction.

• Take it to the field. Verification and validation, release and configuration control, and the sustainment path for fielded software. Write requirements for SEIT and V&V engineers to test and validate your system.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 6+ years building software for robotic or autonomous systems, including at least one system you carried from concept to field deployment

• Strong engineering background, ideally in Robotics, Computer Science, Aerospace, or Electrical Engineering

• Experience leading multidisciplinary software teams, including hiring

• Strong Rust or C++ for real-time and embedded systems, plus Python for tools and analysis

• Deep experience in target tracking and sensor fusion: state estimation, filtering, data association, and track quality on small, maneuvering targets

• Experience with guidance, motion planning, or control for fast-moving vehicles, and a working grasp of the latency and bandwidth tradeoffs that come with it

• Experience integrating and characterizing perception sensors in software.

• Experience building

Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide , including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole , Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars , hundreds of contributors, and a fast-growing global community. About the role Kestra runs arbitrary, user-defined code at scale. Our users write workflows that execute scripts, containers, and queries against their own production systems, through hundreds of community-built plugins, on a platform whose entire source code is public. That is an unusually rich attack surface, and securing it is a genuinely hard engineering problem rather than a checklist exercise. You would be our first dedicated security hire. We're looking for a Senior Security Engineer to own and elevate the end-to-end security posture of our platform, infrastructure, and open-source ecosystem. This is a unique, hybrid role for someone who excels at both sides of security: actively breaking systems to find vulnerabilities (hands-on penetration testing) and actively fixing them (opening PRs, patching infrastructure, and managing supply chain risks). If you want to build a world-class security foundation for a fast-growing open-source and SaaS platform, this role is for you. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a GRC or compliance one. What you would do Your first six months would focus on the first three points below. The rest is where the role grows.

title: Chief of Staff - CFO
description:
About the Role

Abnormal AI stops the attacks other tools miss by understanding the behavior of every identity inside an organization. We protect more than 5,000 customers, including 30% of the Fortune 500, and we are growing from one product to a five-product AI Security suite. This role makes sure Finance keeps up.

The Chief of Staff to the CFO runs the CFO's most important strategic programs and makes sure they finish. You will sit in the room where priorities are set, then own the follow-through across Finance, GTM, R&D, Legal, and People. It is a high-autonomy, high-trust role, and nobody has written the playbook. You will see the full operating picture of a fast-growing company and shape how it matures.

AI is part of the job, not a side project. You will run Finance's AI adoption, build tools the team actually uses, and show others what is possible.

What you'll own

• Strategic programs. Run cross-functional programs for the CFO and strategy team: scope, milestones, owners, a weekly cadence, and a one-page status for the executive team. Escalate blockers early.

• Scale and controls. Own a program across 8 functional areas, from Accounting and controls to IT, cyber, and People, tracked against quarterly targets. Manage workstreams with external auditors and legal counsel.

• Finance operating rhythm. Run goal-setting, check-ins, and progress reporting, and track commitments across the CFO's direct reports so open items close on time.

• AI in Finance. Run recurring enablement and build practical tools for real workflows, such as performance review drafting, talent review intake, and action-item tracking. Report impact in hours saved and adoption.

• Talent, international expansion, and ESG. Run Finance talent reviews, the pulse survey, and team learning. Own the framework for deciding where Abnormal can sell, transact, and hire. Run the ESG engagement.

What 12 months looks like

• The executive team gets a one-page status every week, and no program surprises them.

• Finance commitments close on their date, and slips are visible before they happen.

• AI adoption in Finance rises every quarter, measured in hours saved and active users.

What you bring

• 12+ years in a Chief of Staff, program management, strategy and operations, or consulting role, ideally with Finance exposure or time at a late-stage, high-growth SaaS company.

• A record of running multi-stakeholder programs with hard deadlines, such as an audit, a systems implementation, or a compliance effort.

• You turn ambiguity into owners and dates, and you have started programs from a blank page.

• Strong writing and executive presence. You will represent the CFO in leadership settings.

• You push for dates and hold senior people to their commitments without making it personal.

• You use AI to change how work gets done, and you can show us something you built.

Nice to Have

• MBA or equivalent experience

• AI or cybersecurity SaaS experience

• Experience in Finance talent and culture programs

title: Director/ Senior Director, Lab Platform Engineering
locationText: Cambridge, MA USA; San Francisco, CA USA
description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila is hiring a Director of Lab Platform Engineering to lead the team that builds and operates the hybrid on-premises and cloud infrastructure behind our automated labs. You will own the platform strategy for a fleet of distributed lab sites and lead the engineers who make new sites come online reliably and repeatably.

Lab Platform Engineering builds and supports the platforms and software that keep Lila's AI Science Factory™ running: bare metal clusters, cloud infrastructure, secure identity and secrets services, resilient storage, and the APIs and tooling that let scientists and engineers ship software to production. Every robot, instrument, and lab workflow depends on these systems.

This is a leadership role on a team being built now. You will grow the organization to 10 to 15 engineers, set multi-year technical direction, and partner with robotics, lab operations, research, and security leaders on what the platform needs to support next.

What You'll Be Building

• Build and lead a team of 10 to 15 engineers, including managers and tech leads. Hire, develop, and retain engineers at every level.

• Set multi-year technical vision and strategy for hybrid edge and cloud infrastructure across distributed lab sites.

• Own platform roadmap and delivery, shipping on a predictable cadence against commitments made to partner teams.

• Own fleet operations and reliability, including service levels, on-call, and incident response across sites.

• Own infrastructure budget, capacity planning, and vendor relationships.

• Partner cross-functionally with robotics, lab operations, research, and security, and communicate platform strategy and tradeoffs to executives.

• Raise the engineering bar through standards, review practices, and technical thought leadership.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• 15+ years in software or infrastructure engineering, with 8+ years leading teams, including managing managers or tech leads, or equivalent practical experience.

• Track record building and scaling a platform or infrastructure organization from a small team upward.

• Deep technical grounding in hybrid on-premises and cloud infrastructure, including Kubernetes operated at scale outside the public cloud.

• Experience operating production fleets against explicit reliability targets, with ownership of on-call and incident practice.

• Ownership of infrastructure budget, capacity planning, and vendor negotiation.

• Proven cross-functional and executive partnership, including communicating technical tradeoffs to non-engineering leaders.

• Demonstrated ability to hire and develop senior and principal-level engineers.

Bonus Points For

• Scientific domain: laboratory automation, robotics, or hardware-adjacent platforms; lab software for life sciences or materials science.

• Distributed and edge systems: multi-site operations, intermittently connected environments, over-the-air software rollout.

• Security and compliance: identity and secrets management across hybrid environments, operating in regulated or audited settings.

• Platform practice: infrastructure-as-code, GitOps, developer experience as a product, AI-assisted engineering workflows adopted across a team.

• Organizational: standing up a new function, integrating acquired or transferred teams, managing a team split across offices and remote.

Compensation

We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.

Position Overview
The Legal Intake Specialist plays a pivotal role as the first step in the healthcare medical records retrieval process. This position ensures that every request is accurate, complete, and optimized for downstream success. The precision and quality of the intake process directly influence the speed and accuracy of medical record retrieval for law firm clients.

• Identify all relevant healthcare providers involved in a clients treatment, beyond the main facility listed by the law firm.

• Research and locate billing providers and related entities using tools such as Chartswap, historical request data, and direct provider outreach.

• Accurately input all identified providers into the admin application.

2. Request Creation & Quality Control

• Review incoming ROIs (Release of Information forms), correcting incomplete or inaccurate submissions (noting that ~90% require adjustments).

• Prepare accurate base forms before generating submission packets.

• Conduct comprehensive quality assurance checks on each ROI packet, verifying inclusion of all required details such as cover letters, affidavits, and other documentation.

3. Request Assignment

• Assign requests to the appropriate records team members based on workload balance and utilization metrics.
4. Handling Special Cases

• Identify and escalate special provider requirements (e.g., unique forms or protocols) to the assigned Client Success Manager (CSM).

• Resolve missing, unclear, or conflicting information by liaising with the law firms case manager.

Requirements

•
Experience: Prior hands-on experience requesting health records from providers on behalf of law firms.

•
Attention to Detail: Exceptional accuracy; even small mistakes can cause delays of several months.

•
Technical Skills: Proficiency with Adobe Acrobat and other PDF editing/combining tools.

title: Director / Senior Director, AI x Lab Integration
locationText: Cambridge, MA USA; San Francisco, CA USA
description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila is building a platform where AI and automation co-evolve to accelerate scientific discovery. Within AI Research, the AI x Lab Integration team develops the capabilities that allow reasoning models to translate scientific intent into executable experiments.

We are seeking a Director, AI x Lab Integration to further grow and lead this team. You will set the research agenda for models that understand the purpose of a protocol, compose experiments against real laboratory constraints, diagnose failures, and adapt protocols as evidence arrives. Your work will help LLMs hone scientific judgment and learn from practical knowledge needed to turn a research question into a reliable experimental workflow.

This is a hands-on research leadership role. You will recruit exceptional researchers, make consequential technical decisions, and establish rigorous evidence that model improvements transfer to real experiments. You will partner closely with domain scientists and the teams responsible for laboratory execution, data infrastructure, and orchestration.

What You'll Be Building

• The lab intelligence research agenda: Lead research across protocol understanding, intent-to-protocol generation, feasibility assessment, protocol repair, failure diagnosis, and adaptation based on experimental results.

• Learning from scientific expertise: Partner with the scientists to turn expert demonstrations, corrections, and experimental feedback into model improvements that capture tacit scientific knowledge.

• Post-training methods for laboratory reasoning: Lead research in supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, tool use, and learning from execution feedback. Determine which methods improve scientific validity, execution success, and generalization to unfamiliar protocols and conditions.

• Rigorous capability evaluation: Establish independent evaluations spanning individual protocol skills, decisions made during a run, and workflows that cross scientific domains. Measure scientific correctness, feasibility, execution outcomes, uncertainty, and the need for human intervention.

• A high-performing research team: Hire, mentor, and lead scientists and research engineers. Set clear ownership, maintain strong experimental standards, and build a culture of ambitious hypotheses, careful measurement, and rapid learning.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Robotics, Computational Science, or a related field, or equivalent research and leadership experience.

• A substantial track record of leading original AI research and translating it into capabilities that work beyond a benchmark.

• Demonstrated experience developing AI capabilities for automated laboratories, scientific agents, or closed-loop experimentation, with model decisions informed by real experimental results.

• Experience building and leading research teams, including recruiting strong scientists and engineers, developing technical leaders, and setting priorities under uncertainty.

• The ability to engage deeply with experimental scientists and translate scientific objectives, controls, and failure modes into tractable research problems.

• A hands-on leadership style: comfortable reviewing model behavior, challenging research designs, interpreting failure cases, and guiding technical decisions.

Bonus Points For

• Deep technical expertise in foundation models, post-training, reinforcement learning, agent learning, or closely related methods.

• Research in procedural reasoning, program synthesis, planning, causal reasoning, or uncertainty-aware decision-making.

•
Nosso objetivo - Potencializar os negócios dos nossos clientes através de soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis. Topa vir com a gente nessa? 🎯

O que buscamos?
Buscamos um Desenvolvedor Golang com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento de APIs e aplicações backend, perfil analítico, autonomia na execução das demandas e comprometimento com a qualidade das entregas em ambientes ágeis e colaborativos.
Como será o seu dia a dia:

• Experiência prática com desenvolvimento em Go (Golang).

• Desenvolver e evoluir serviços backend utilizando Go (Golang).

• Implementar e manter um BFF responsável pela integração com APIs do Core VTEX.

• Desenvolver APIs REST escaláveis e seguras para consumo por aplicações web e mobile.

• Realizar integrações com serviços de catálogo, preços, estoque, checkout, pedidos e clientes da VTEX.

• Vivência com containers (Docker) e conceitos de cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).

• Experiência com testes unitários e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.

Conhecimento Técnicos:

• Experiência com consumo e integração de APIs.

• Capacidade de utilizar IA como acelerador de produtividade em atividades de desenvolvimento, análise de código, documentação e testes.

Serão diferenciais

• Experiência com plataforma VTEX .

• Conhecimento dos módulos VTEX Catalog, Checkout, OMS e Pricing.

• Experiência com CI/CD.

• Experiência com Flutter para entendimento e suporte às integrações com aplicações mobile.

• Conhecimento em PHP para manutenção e integração com sistemas legados.

• Conhecimento em Kubernetes e orquestração de containers.

• Espanhol (operação Colômbia)

title: Futures Compliance Senior Specialist
description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

Robinhood Derivatives, LLC (RHD) is Robinhood's CFTC-regulated futures commission merchant and NFA member, offering customers access to futures, options on futures, and event contracts. The RHD Compliance team is small, hands-on, and in build mode. We partner with Legal, Risk, Operations, Product, and Engineering to launch new derivatives products the right way, with clear regulations helping us build, innovate, and scale with confidence.

As the Futures Compliance Senior Specialist, you will directly report to the Chief Compliance Officer of RHD and be a core member of the team. You will help run and strengthen the day-to-day compliance program for our futures business, from policies and supervision to product reviews, marketing approvals, and regulatory interactions. This is a hands-on role for someone who knows futures regulation well and wants to help shape a program as the business grows.

This role is based in our Chicago, IL office , with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

What you’ll do

• Support the design, operation, and ongoing testing of the RHD compliance program under the Commodity Exchange Act, CFTC regulations, and NFA rules

• Draft, update, and maintain Written Supervisory Procedures (WSPs), policies, and internal controls as products, rules, and business processes change

• Advise Product, Engineering, Operations, and Legal on the regulatory requirements for new and existing futures, options on futures, and event contract offerings, including customer-facing flows and disclosures

• Review and approve marketing, social media, and other communications for compliance with NFA and CFTC standards, working through our Red Oak review workflow

• Complete regulatory and exchange responses, including timely, accurate responses to NFA, CFTC, exchange, and clearing firm examinations, inquiries, and document requests, and track remediation of any findings through to closure

• Handle the registration process for Associated Persons (APs), including Series 3 testing and registration and the filing of NFA Forms 8-R (registration) and 8-T (termination) in NFA's Online Registration System, and keep AP registration records current

• Respond to 4g requests

• Support regulatory filings and recurring obligations, including the NFA annual self-examination and required notices and reports

• Support the firm's risk management program requirements under CFTC Regulation 1.11, and contribute to compliance monitoring, testing, and reporting to senior management

• Review and escalate trade surveillance and monitoring alerts, working with Risk, Trading, and Operations to investigate and document outcomes

• Own the customer complaint adjudication process for the futures business, from intake and investigation through resolution, documentation, and trend reporting

• Support KYC and customer onboarding processes as they relate to the futures business

• Track CFTC, NFA, and exchange rule changes and industry developments, and translate them into clear, practical guidance for the business

• Contribute to the annual CCO report, Board reporting, and compliance training for RHD personnel

title: Director Global Benefits
description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Harvey is scaling fast across headcount, geographies, and the complexity that comes with both. Our benefits and leave programs are now the daily, tangible experience of working here for employees in a dozen countries, and they need an owner who can lead them at that scale.

We're looking for our first Director of Global Benefits to own Harvey's benefits and leave of absence strategy end to end, building on the foundations we have as we head into the next phase of our growth. You'll set the philosophy and stay close enough to the work to know whether a plan design holds up in practice.

This is a player/coach role for someone who has built and run a global benefits function before, ideally in a fast-scaling environment. You'll manage and grow our global benefits team, while engaging deeply in our highest-stakes workstreams: annual renewals, open enrollment, new-country launches, and the vendor relationships that underpin it all. You'll also own how benefits support feels day to day. Most employees meet this function through a single question at a stressful moment, and how that's handled matters as much as the plan design behind it.

You'll report to our Head of Total Rewards and partner closely with People Operations, Payroll, Finance, Legal, and Recruiting.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Strategy and plan design

- Define Harvey's global benefits and leave philosophy, including what "global consistency, local relevance" means as we enter new markets.

- Lead plan design and redesign across the US and our international footprint (10+ markets and growing), balancing employee impact, competitiveness, and cost.

- Build a program roadmap and business case for benefits, wellness, and leave, grounded in benchmarking and market analysis.

Team and service delivery

- Grow and develop the global benefits team across the US and EMEA, setting priorities, raising the operating bar, and creating room for people to stretch.

- Set and hold the standard for service delivery: response times, escalation, and follow-through on employee questions. Use AI and automation to take volume off the team without letting the experience get more distant.

- Make our benefits legible, with clear, honest, localized communication so employees use what we offer and a partnership with Recruiting that makes our benefits a real differentiator in candidate conversations.

Programs, vendors, and spend

- Oversee the annual cycle end to end: renewals, open enrollment, plan changes, carrier transitions, and new-country benefit launches.

- Lead the global leave of absence program with consistency and care as volume scales.

- Hold brokers, carriers, and third-party administrators to account globally, including RFPs, negotiations, contracting, and performance management.

Engagement model: Independent Contractor/Freelance
Project start: November 2026
Estimated project duration: until end of 2026
Estimated workload: up to 20 hours in total
Required Languages: English
About the Role
We are looking for experienced professionals and subject-matter experts to contribute to an AI training and evaluation project focused on the creation of realistic professional knowledge-based tasks.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in the Supply Chain and Procurement sector and understands how real workplace assignments are completed.

The ideal candidate is also comfortable using modern LLM tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms.

What You’ll Do

• Develop realistic professional task scenarios based on your work experience in different roles within the above-mentioned sectors.

• Create and review supporting business materials such as spreadsheets, reports, presentations, documents, datasets, or other occupation-specific files.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional qualification, where appropriate.

• Minimum 3 years of relevant professional work experience in a relevant role in the Supply Chain and Procurement sector.

• Be located in thePhilippines.

• Strong practical knowledge of workflows, tools, terminology, standards, and deliverables used in your profession.

• Have experience using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar AI tools.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Experience working with multiple documents, data sources, reports, spreadsheets, presentations, or similar professional materials.

• Strong written English (all the project related task creation will be done in English)

• Ability to distinguish realistic professional work from overly simplified or artificial scenarios.

• Experience creating, reviewing, validating, auditing, or quality-checking professional work is a plus.

• Experience developing training materials, case studies, or professional assessments is a plus.
